129:t_1:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「...So the $$サイデリアル$$ really are about to begin their invasion of Japan.」

129:t_1:5.en:
$$大塚$$
「The Far East Branch has committed most of its strength to the battle to defend 《$$新日本$$》 right now, so we inevitably have a weak spot.」

129:t_1:6.en:
$$大塚$$
「The Empire struck at that weak spot, and ever since you were thrown into space, their reconnaissance units have shown up again and again.」

129:t_1:7.en:
$$レイアム$$
「What are Japan's Super Robot forces doing?」

129:t_1:8.en:
$$大塚$$
「The $$クラッシャー隊$$ is on a separate mission in space, and it will take time for them to return.」

129:t_1:9.en:
$$大塚$$
「$$２１世紀警備保障$$ is also on refugee rescue duty in Central Asia, which is under the Empire's control.」

129:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we can't call them back, we have no choice but to defend Japan ourselves.」

129:t_1:11.en:
$$大塚$$
「With every continent engulfed in war, Japan has managed to stay relatively peaceful.」

129:t_1:12.en:
$$大塚$$
「That is why Japan is expected to be the center of our coming counteroffensive against the Empire.」

129:t_1:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ must know that as well, which is exactly why they're targeting Japan.」

129:t_1:14.en:
$$大塚$$
「We have our hands full with the situation in front of us, so we still haven't even been able to investigate the former $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ site.」

129:t_1:15.en:
$$大塚$$
「I'm sorry to ask, but I want all of you to come to Japan as soon as you possibly can.」

129:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood, Director $$大塚$$. The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will descend to Earth and head straight for the old $$第３新東京市$$.」

129:t_1:22.en:
$n
「Are you worried about what $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is doing?」

129:t_1:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll leave that side to $$刹那$$ and the others. What's on my mind right now is Japan.」

129:t_1:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Your school is there, too, after all.」

129:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I haven't talked about it much, but until not long ago, I was a high school student myself.」

129:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I'd heard you were in a guerrilla organization called $$エゥーゴ$$...」

129:t_1:29.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think about it sometimes... If I hadn't boarded a $$ガンダム$$ back then and had stayed a student, what would have become of me...」

129:t_1:30.en:
$n
「Do you want to go back to those days?」

129:t_1:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...That's not it. They weren't all good memories.」

129:t_1:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's just... even back there, there were things I treasured.」

129:t_1:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why I don't want to see people who live like that have their everyday lives taken from them for no reason.」

129:t_1:36.en:
$n
「That's why I fight... And now I have the power to do it.」

129:t_1:37.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're like $$セツコ$$ in that way.」

129:t_1:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「An old comrade of ours... And the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$.」

129:t_1:40.en:
$n
「So she's one of the three Reactors who were in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$...」

129:t_1:41.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$ and I have known her since the $$多元戦争$$ in the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

129:t_1:42.en:
$n
「I heard a little about her from $$シン$$. That she has the strength not to be beaten by sadness.」

129:t_1:43.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right. That's what made me think she's like you.」

129:t_1:44.en:
$n
「...I'm not that admirable a person. I was only fighting to vent the anger inside me and to escape my fear.」

129:t_1:45.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I told you before. I started fighting for personal reasons, too.」

129:t_1:46.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In the end, I'm still fighting over my own feelings and wishes, so I haven't changed much.」

129:t_1:48.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We don't need anyone to praise us or respect us. But if you think we can change something by fighting, then let's do it.」

129:t_1:50.en:
$n
「...Could it be that you... knew I hadn't gotten over the $$シンジ$$ thing, and...」

129:t_1:51.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アルト$$ and $$宗介$$ aren't here right now. Not that I'm filling in for them, but I decided to meddle a little.」

129:t_1:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We look out for each other. I got help from $$シン$$ over the Colonel, too.」

129:t_1:54.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So if somebody's in trouble, you lend them a hand, too.」

129:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Yeah... That's what I intend to do.」

129:t_1:56.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In your case, the first thing might be making sure you don't cause Miss $$スズネ$$ any trouble.」

129:t_1:57.en:
$n
「...I can't say a word back to that.」

129:t_1:58.en:
$n
「While I've got the chance, tell me. What do I have to do to become an equal partner to Miss $$スズネ$$?」

129:t_1:59.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't ask me something like that...」

129:t_1:60.en:
$n
「You just told me to help out a friend in trouble!」

129:t_1:61.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「R-Right now, I'm the one in trouble...」

129:t_1:62.en:
$n
「Please, $$カミーユ$$! I asked $$アルト$$ and $$甲児$$ too, but all I got back were answers that missed the point entirely!」

129:t_1:63.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And what were those answers?」

129:t_1:64.en:
$n
「Buy her flowers on anniversaries, praise her when she changes her hairstyle, pat her on the head when she's sad...」

129:t_1:65.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Those two, giving irresponsible advice...」

129:t_1:66.en:
$n
「As for Captain $$クラン$$, it went off on some baffling tangent and I got lectured for two hours.」

129:t_1:67.en:
$n
「When I complained about that to $$千鳥$$, it took another baffling turn, and this time I got lectured for three hours.」

129:t_1:69.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did you talk to $$宗介$$ about this?」

129:t_1:70.en:
$n
「...Do you want to hear his answer?」

129:t_1:72.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What's the matter, $n, $$カミーユ$$? You two seem to be getting worked up.」

129:t_1:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
「S-Sorry...! Of course there are things you don't want a woman to hear.」

129:t_1:77.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're at that age, after all. I guess that can't be helped...」

129:t_1:78.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But $$カミーユ$$... Don't do anything that would make $$ファ$$ or $$フォウ$$ sad.」

129:t_1:80.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We'll be descending to Earth soon, so please start getting ready.」

129:t_1:81.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait a moment, Miss $$スズネ$$! I...」

129:t_1:82.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... It's all right, $$カミーユ$$. I'll keep it a secret from Lieutenant $$エマ$$ and Captain $$アムロ$$.」

129:t_1:84.en:
$n
「Give it up, $$カミーユ$$. Once Miss $$スズネ$$ gets an idea in her head, she doesn't budge easily.」

129:t_1:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「An equal partner to her, huh...」

uncertain: 129:t_1:42: あいつ taken as Shinn (named in the previous line); could be someone else.
